# Agent Etiquette

> Model-agnostic multi-agent governance protocol, handoff JSON schemas, Rule-of-2 escalation guardrails, and verified-artifact standards for any AI coding agent.

## Agent Entry Points (All Models)
- `AGENTS.md` — Universal project guardrails and agent operating rules.
- `HANDOFF.md` — Active session state, verification command, and next step.
- `mistakes.md` — Permanent "Never Repeat" guardrail log.
- `skills/` — Reusable model-agnostic skills (`SKILL.md`).
- `schemas/` — JSON Schema contracts for structured inter-agent handoffs.

## Key Paths
- `schemas/` — Handoff & governance JSON schemas.
- `scripts/` — Validation and installation helpers.
- `docs/` — Protocol guides and architecture references.
- `tests/` — Protocol validation test suite.
- `demo/preview.svg` — Visual governance workflow preview.

## Verification Command
`ls -la AGENTS.md HANDOFF.md mistakes.md llms.txt schemas/ skills/`
